name: defect-several
purpose: Add order pricing in cents. subtotal sums priceCents times quantity for every line. discount takes 10% off a subtotal of 10000 cents or more, otherwise 0. shipping costs 500 cents below a 5000-cent subtotal and is free from 5000 cents upward. total is subtotal minus discount plus shipping. formatCents renders cents as dollars with exactly two decimals: 1230 becomes "$12.30".
